zh-CN: 表格行操作驱动整个生命周期：成员提交、重试、停止；评审人与维护者批准、驳回、要求修改、验收。排队、运行与已交付的需求定义被冻结
en-US: Row actions drive the lifecycle: members submit, retry and stop; reviewers and maintainers approve, reject, request changes and accept. A requirement is frozen while queued, running or delivered

zh-CN: 从领取需求到推送交付六步走完，git 全部由 erupt-git 代劳，任意 git 托管都能接
en-US: Six steps from claiming a requirement to pushing the delivery; every git operation goes through erupt-git, so any git host works

zh-CN: 执行器轮询队列，用条件更新领取需求，多实例部署也不会重复领取同一张单
en-US: The executor polls the queue and claims with a conditional update, so two instances never take the same requirement

zh-CN: 每个仓库拉取后从 origin/<base> 检出 req/req-n 的 worktree；项目的 AGENTS.md 写入根目录，CLAUDE.md 引用它
en-US: Each repository is fetched and a worktree on req/req-n is checked out from origin/<base>; the project AGENTS.md lands at the root with a CLAUDE.md that imports it

zh-CN: 创建需求时选定的编码 CLI 在工作区运行，提示词走 stdin；每条消息实时存为 Agent Event，进度通过 MCP 汇报；重试与改需求会 --resume 上一次会话
en-US: The CLI picked when the requirement was created runs in the workspace with the prompt on stdin; every message is stored as an Agent Event as it arrives, progress is reported over MCP, and a retry resumes the previous session

zh-CN: Agent 留下的未提交改动以它的名义提交，工作区里不会有遗漏
en-US: Anything the agent left uncommitted is committed in its name, so nothing is left behind in the workspace

zh-CN: 按需开启：同一执行器再跑一轮检查改动，通过 MCP devReportVerdict 给出结论；无 MCP 的 CLI 用 VERDICT 标记行
en-US: Optional per requirement: a second run of the same executor checks the change and reports a verdict over MCP; CLIs without MCP print a VERDICT marker line

zh-CN: 人工验收后，有目标分支的仓库 rebase 到目标并 fast-forward 推送，否则推送 req/req-n；所有仓库先 rebase 再推送，冲突时任何仓库都不被触碰，每次推送记一条 Delivery
en-US: After human acceptance, a repository with a target branch is rebased and pushed fast-forward only, otherwise req/req-n is pushed; all repositories rebase before the first push, so a conflict leaves every one untouched, and each push is a Delivery record

zh-CN: 服务器上装了哪个，就能选哪个
en-US: Pick any coding CLI installed on the server

zh-CN: 选择器只列出服务器 PATH 上找得到的 CLI，新装的半分钟内出现；Claude Code、Cursor、Qwen 共用同一个 stream-json 解析器
en-US: The picker lists only CLIs found on the server PATH, and a new install shows up within half a minute; Claude Code, Cursor and Qwen share one stream-json parser

zh-CN: 提示词走 stdin 或末位参数，文本输出；在 yaml 里加一个键即可接入，无需写代码
en-US: Prompt on stdin or as the last argument, text out; one key in yaml adds it, no code

zh-CN: 需要真正解析输出的 CLI，实现 CodingAgentRunner 并注册为 Spring Bean
en-US: For a CLI that needs real parsing, implement CodingAgentRunner as a Spring bean

zh-CN: Agent 拿的是一次性工牌，不是 root
en-US: The agent holds a one-run badge, not root

zh-CN: 一个能执行命令的进程该拿什么权限？答案是：只属于这一次运行、只指向这一张需求单的令牌，数据权限继承需求创建者在 AI 对话里本来就有的那一份
en-US: What should a process that runs commands be allowed to do? A token minted for this one run and this one requirement, with data access inherited from what its creator may already do in AI chat

zh-CN: 每次运行签发随机 bearer 令牌，结束即作废；只能触达自己的需求单，只能调用自己角色的工具：开发者 devReportProgress，QA devReportVerdict
en-US: A random bearer token is minted per run and revoked when it ends; it reaches only its own requirement and calls only its role's tools: devReportProgress for the developer, devReportVerdict for QA

zh-CN: Agent 进程只拿到 PATH、HOME、LANG 等基础变量与 executor.env 里显式配置的内容；数据库密码等服务器机密永远不会进入它
en-US: The agent process gets PATH, HOME, LANG and what executor.env explicitly lists; server secrets such as database passwords never reach it

zh-CN: 拉取与推送全部由 erupt 自己完成；凭据只用于 credentials.<key>.hosts 列出的主机，项目里填的仓库地址带不走它
en-US: Erupt does every fetch and push itself; a credential goes only to the hosts listed under credentials.<key>.hosts, so a repository URL typed into a project cannot carry it elsewhere

zh-CN: --strict-mcp-config 把账号下其他 MCP 服务器挡在运行之外；MCP 配置文件以 0600 写入 run/ 目录，运行结束即删除；CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR 可指向专用目录
en-US: --strict-mcp-config keeps the account's other MCP servers out; the MCP config file is written to run/ with mode 0600 and deleted afterwards; CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR can point at a dedicated directory

zh-CN: 运行附带 erupt 自己的 @AiToolbox 工具，以需求创建者的身份在其租户下执行，上限是该创建者 AI 角色允许的范围——它读不到创建者读不到的东西
en-US: The run carries erupt's own @AiToolbox tools, executed as the requirement's creator in their tenant and limited to what that creator's AI roles allow — it reads nothing the creator could not

zh-CN: executor.clis.<code>.args 决定无头运行能用哪些工具；建议只在一台专用容器或虚拟机上安装 CLI，Agent 以服务器账号读写文件、执行命令
en-US: executor.clis.<code>.args grants the tools a headless run may use; install the CLI on one dedicated container or VM, since the agent edits files and runs commands with the server's account

zh-CN: 机密只放配置（环境变量或密钥管理器注入），从不进数据库；项目、仓库、成员都是普通 Erupt 模型，用注解生成的后台管理
en-US: Secrets live only in configuration, injected through environment variables or a secret manager, never in the database; projects, repositories and members are ordinary Erupt models managed by annotation-generated pages

zh-CN: 租户内唯一的 code 同时是磁盘目录名；一个项目挂多个仓库与成员，内置 AGENTS.md、活跃工作区清理与自评开关
en-US: A code unique per tenant that is also the directory name; a project holds several repositories and members, with AGENTS.md, leftover-workspace cleanup and a self-review switch

zh-CN: 非成员看不到也选不到项目，超级管理员例外；创建者即 OWNER，所有者与维护者改设置、仓库和成员，项目至少保留一位
en-US: Non-members never list, open or pick a project; super admins see all. The creator becomes OWNER; owners and maintainers change settings, repositories and members, and a project keeps at least one

zh-CN: 页头选一次项目，列表、详情、写入全部跟随；选项每次请求重新校验，手改 erupt-scope 请求头也到不了无权项目
en-US: Pick a project once in the page header and every list, detail and write follows; options are re-checked on every request, so a hand-edited erupt-scope header reaches no project the user is not in

zh-CN: {root}/repos/{tenant}/{project}/{alias}.git 裸仓库后台同步；{root}/worktrees/{tenant}/{project}/{req-n}/{alias} 是 Agent 的工作目录；每个实体带 @TenantId，每段路径都经校验

en-US: Current tenant ID, name, status, expiry and packages

配置中心不必是另一个服务

zh-CN: 后台里的配置项就是 Spring 环境里最前面的那一层 PropertySource：@Value、Environment、@ConfigurationProperties 照常读，按 profile 分层，保存之后不重启就生效。
en-US: Items in the admin become the first PropertySource in the Spring environment: @Value, Environment and @ConfigurationProperties read them as usual, layered per profile, and a saved change reaches running beans without a restart.

zh-CN: 已关闭 · 回落到文件值

en-US: How a value reaches the application

zh-CN: 启动前用纯 JDBC 读库放到所有文件之前；运行时保存一项，三步刷新本节点；多节点靠 Redis 广播或轮询。
en-US: Before the context starts, plain JDBC reads the database and puts it in front of every file; at runtime a save refreshes this node in three steps; other nodes hear it over Redis or by polling.

zh-CN: EruptConfigEnvironmentPostProcessor 在任何 Bean 创建之前，用 spring.datasource.* 直连数据库读出分层后的 profile，合并结果 addFirst 放在所有文件之前。库里还没有表时只打一行 warn，首次启动照用文件里的值。
en-US: EruptConfigEnvironmentPostProcessor runs before any bean exists: it reads the layered profiles over spring.datasource.* with plain JDBC and addFirst's the merged map ahead of every file. No tables yet means one warn line and the first boot runs on the files.

zh-CN: DataProxy 的 afterAdd / afterUpdate / afterDelete 只做一件事：refresh。整体替换 PropertySource，让每个单例上的 @Value 字段重新取值，再发 EruptConfigRefreshedEvent 带上变化的 key。
en-US: The DataProxy's afterAdd / afterUpdate / afterDelete do one thing: refresh. The PropertySource is replaced whole, every singleton's @Value field is resolved again, and EruptConfigRefreshedEvent carries the keys that changed.

zh-CN: 开了 erupt.redis-session 就在变更提交后通过 Redis 广播，其他实例立即刷新；没有 Redis 的集群设 refresh-seconds 轮询，安静的一次轮询只有两条聚合查询，不读任何值。单实例什么都不用设。
en-US: With erupt.redis-session on, the change is broadcast over Redis once it commits and the others refresh at once; a cluster without Redis sets refresh-seconds to poll, and a quiet poll is two aggregate queries that read no values. A single instance needs neither.

zh-CN: 配置中心最大的成本不是存储，是让所有已有代码改用新的读法。所以干脆不要有新读法。
en-US: The real cost of a config center is not storage, it is making every existing line of code read a new way. So there is no new way.

zh-CN: 保存后字段自动跟着变
带类型和默认值，key 可以是枚举
en-US: typed, with a default; the key may be an enum

zh-CN: 需要重建连接的地方监听事件
en-US: listen where a connection must be rebuilt

en-US: The active profile layers over default, default over the files, exactly as application-{profile}.yml layers over application.yml. A key missing from the database falls through to the files.

zh-CN: 只放和 default 不同的那几项
en-US: holds only what differs from default

zh-CN: 每个实例都读的那一层
兜底：库里没有的 key 在这里
en-US: the floor: keys the database lacks

zh-CN: 沿用 Spring 的，没有 erupt 专属项
多节点且无 Redis 会话时才需要
en-US: only for a cluster without Redis sessions

表单用 @Dynamic 按类型切换编辑器；表格里按类型绘制：色块、图标、图片缩略、附件链接、标签列表。密文项显示 ••••••，应用仍能读到。
en-US: The form switches editors by type with @Dynamic; the table draws each value by type: a swatch, the icon, a thumbnail, an attachment link, tags. A secret shows ••••••, the application still reads it.

zh-CN: password 强制为密文；html 用富文本编辑器
en-US: password is always a secret; html gets a rich editor

zh-CN: 展平成 key.path 和 key[i] 属性，和 Spring 读 yml 一致，Map / List / @ConfigurationProperties 直接绑定
en-US: Flattened into key.path and key[i] properties, the way Spring reads yml, so a Map, a List or a @ConfigurationProperties bean binds directly

zh-CN: number 绑定到数值类型，boolean 绑定到开关，日期时间按 Spring 的转换规则
en-US: number binds to numeric types, boolean to a switch, date and time through Spring's converters

zh-CN: 上传类型的属性值是它在 erupt.upload-path 下的路径

en-US: Versus a system-param table and Nacos / Apollo

zh-CN: 靠 key 前缀或每个环境一个库

zh-CN: 互不相识，同名 key 看代码怎么写

zh-CN: 远端优先，本地文件做回退

zh-CN: 活动 profile > default > 文件；缺的 key 自动落回文件

zh-CN: 不需要：和后台同进程，用 spring.datasource.* 读库

zh-CN: 历史版本、灰度、发布审批

zh-CN: 取不到库就退回文件的值，这是为首次启动设计的退路，不是高可用方案。它也不是数据字典：EruptDict 驱动下拉框，这个模块驱动代码。
en-US: Unreachable database means the files' values, a first-boot fallback rather than high availability. Nor is it a data dictionary: EruptDict feeds dropdowns, this module feeds code.

zh-CN: 引入依赖，菜单里多出 Config
en-US: Add the dependency, a Config menu appears

zh-CN: 新建一个 app.mail.host，再用 @Value("${app.mail.host:localhost}") 读它。profile 沿用 spring.profiles.active，什么都不用再配。
en-US: Create app.mail.host, then read it with @Value("${app.mail.host:localhost}"). Profiles follow spring.profiles.active, nothing else to set.

zh-CN: 任意语言接入 Erupt 后台
en-US: Serve admin pages from any language

zh-CN: 拖出来的模型，和手写的一样
en-US: A dragged model is a hand-written model

zh-CN: 运行时拖拽设计 Erupt 实体模型，发布后自动注册为数据管理菜单，无需重启；设计结果一键导出为 Java 注解代码，平滑过渡到手写开发。
en-US: Design Erupt entity models by drag and drop at runtime, publish them straight into the menu without a restart, and export the result as Java annotation code when you are ready to hand-write.

zh-CN: 从一张空表单到一个菜单
en-US: From an empty form to a menu

zh-CN: 六步走完，中间不碰代码、不重启服务；想手写了，第六步把它导出来。
en-US: Six steps, no code and no restart in between; when you want to hand-write, step six exports it.

zh-CN: 进入 Form Designer 菜单，新建一条模型记录，填写类名（Class Name）和名称。
en-US: Open the Form Designer menu and add a record with a class name and a display name.

zh-CN: 点击行按钮 Design 进入设计器，从组件面板拖字段进画布，配置类型、标题、必填、搜索、排序等属性。
en-US: Click the Design row button, drag fields from the palette onto the canvas and set type, title, required, searchable and sortable.

zh-CN: Preview 按真实表单渲染，所见即所得；Views 切换列表视图配置。
en-US: Preview renders the real form; Views switches to the table view settings.

zh-CN: 设计配置保存到 e_designer.config，并在内存中注册为运行时 EruptModel；每次服务启动自动重新注册。
en-US: The design is saved to e_designer.config and registered in memory as a runtime EruptModel; every start re-registers it.

zh-CN: 回到列表点击 Add to Menu，选好位置，菜单立即生效，不用重启。
en-US: Back on the list, click Add to Menu, pick a position, and the menu is live without a restart.

zh-CN: Export Code 生成标准 Java 注解类，放进项目源码替换掉运行时模型，设计到开发平滑过渡。
en-US: Export Code produces a standard annotated Java class; drop it into your source to replace the runtime model.

zh-CN: 设计的尽头是一段注解
导出的就是手写时会写的那份 @Erupt / @EruptField，没有运行时专属的东西留在里面。
en-US: What comes out is the @Erupt / @EruptField you would have typed, with nothing runtime-specific left inside.

zh-CN: 设计 → 开发平滑过渡
导出后把代码放入项目源码，替换掉 designer 管理的运行时模型；菜单和权限配置原样保留。
en-US: Put the exported code in your project and it replaces the designer-managed runtime model; menus and permissions stay as they are.

zh-CN: 若同名的真实 @Erupt 类已存在，设计器无法覆盖它，避免两份定义打架。
en-US: If a real @Erupt class with the same name exists, the designer cannot override it, so two definitions never fight.

zh-CN: 关联字段指向真实模型
REFERENCE_TABLE / REFERENCE_TREE 需要关联到已存在的 Erupt 模型，手写的和设计的可以互相引用。
en-US: REFERENCE_TABLE / REFERENCE_TREE must point at an existing Erupt model; hand-written and designed models can reference each other.

zh-CN: 和注解里的 EditType 一一对应，拖进来的每个组件都能导出成一行 @Edit。
en-US: Each maps to an EditType in the annotations, so every dragged component exports as one @Edit line.

zh-CN: 文本、数字、开关、日期、滑块、评分、颜色、隐藏域
en-US: Text, number, switch, date, slider, rate, colour, hidden

zh-CN: 单选、多选、标签、自动补全；引用字段关联到已存在的 Erupt 模型
en-US: Single, multi, tags, autocomplete; reference fields link to an existing Erupt model

zh-CN: 附件、图片、富文本、Markdown、代码、地图、签名、模板、按钮
en-US: Attachment, image, rich text, Markdown, code, map, signature, template, button

zh-CN: 分隔线、分组、提示框、占位，不落库只排版
en-US: Divider, group, callout, empty: layout only, no column

zh-CN: 业务数据落在一个 SQLite 文件里
en-US: Business data lives in one SQLite file

zh-CN: 2.2.0 起每个已发布的设计对应一张真实表 d_<类名小写>，不受宿主项目用的是哪种数据库影响。
en-US: Since 2.2.0 each published design owns a real table, d_<classname>, independent of whatever database the host project uses.

zh-CN: 标量字段落成原生列，引用与多值字段以 JSON 文本存储：
en-US: Scalar fields become native columns; references and multi-value fields are stored as JSON text:

zh-CN: 相对路径相对 JVM 工作目录
en-US: relative to the JVM working directory

zh-CN: SQLite 单写者，WAL 下读可并发
en-US: one writer; reads concurrent under WAL

zh-CN: 过滤、排序、分页都下推为 SQL；引用和多值字段用 json_extract / json_each 检索。
en-US: Filtering, sorting and paging push down to SQL; references and multi-value fields are queried with json_extract / json_each.

zh-CN: 表结构变更只新增列，不删除、不改类型；字段重命名按发布时分配的字段 id 移动原列，已有数据跟着新名字走。
en-US: Schema changes only add columns, never drop or retype; a renamed field moves its column by the field id assigned at publish, so data follows the new name.

zh-CN: 发布时建表、补列；旧版 2.1.x 的 e_designer_data 不自动迁移，重新发布即得到新表结构。
en-US: Publishing creates or extends the table; 2.1.x data in e_designer_data is not migrated automatically, republish to get the new schema.

zh-CN: designer.db 不在主数据库里，请挂到持久化卷并纳入备份，否则容器重建后设计器数据会丢失。
en-US: designer.db is outside the main database: mount it on a persistent volume and back it up, or a rebuilt container loses the designer's data.

zh-CN: 先拖出来，再决定要不要写
en-US: Drag it first, decide later whether to write it

zh-CN: 引入 erupt-designer，菜单里多出 Form Designer；设计满意了，Export Code 带走。
en-US: Add erupt-designer and a Form Designer menu appears; when the design is right, Export Code takes it with you.

zh-CN: 不想拖？让 Canvas Agent 生成 →
en-US: Rather not drag? Let Canvas Agent generate →

zh-CN: 任何语言，都能长出 Erupt 后台
en-US: Any language can grow an Erupt admin

zh-CN: 节点只交出两样东西：模型描述和数据读写。登录、菜单、权限、校验、Excel、附件全由 erupt 服务端代办，所以一个零依赖的 Python / Go / TypeScript 进程也能安全接入。
en-US: A node hands over two things: the model description and data reads and writes. Login, menus, permissions, validation, Excel and attachments are handled by the erupt server, so a zero-dependency Python, Go or TypeScript process plugs in safely.

zh-CN: 服务端新建节点 blog，复制 access token
en-US: create node blog on the server, copy its token

zh-CN: 加一个 table 菜单，值为 blog.Article
en-US: add a table menu with value blog.Article

zh-CN: 启动节点，服务端能访问到它就行
en-US: run the node where the server can reach it

zh-CN: 每种语言一个包，同一个后台
en-US: One package per language, the same admin

zh-CN: 同一份 blog 示例在九种语言里各实现一遍，服务端渲染出的页面逐一对照。
en-US: The same blog example is implemented in nine languages, and the server renders them side by side.

zh-CN: 节点不是 Spring 应用，是一份协议
en-US: A node is not a Spring app, it is a protocol

zh-CN: 契约定得足够窄，实现它的东西就可以是任何东西。Level 0 只有 7 个端点，实现了就有表格、搜索、详情和增删改。
en-US: Keep the contract narrow enough and anything can implement it. Level 0 is seven endpoints; implement them and you have table, search, detail and CRUD.

zh-CN: 登录、会话、用户：只在服务端，节点没有用户表
en-US: Login, sessions, users: server only, the node has no user table

zh-CN: 菜单与按钮权限：服务端查好后用 Erupt-Enforced 签名告诉节点
en-US: Menus and button permissions: checked on the server, signed to the node as Erupt-Enforced

zh-CN: 每个用户的 power：节点按服务端给的结果执行
en-US: Per-user power: the node acts on what the server decided

zh-CN: 表单校验：按 build JSON 在服务端先校一遍
en-US: Form validation: run on the server against the build JSON first

zh-CN: Excel 导入导出：用节点的 Level 0 接口代办
en-US: Excel import and export: done through the node's Level 0 endpoints

zh-CN: 附件上传、静态选项：节点不实现就回 404，服务端接手
en-US: Uploads and static options: a node that answers 404 is covered by the server

zh-CN: 界面：节点上报 build JSON，服务端渲染
en-US: UI: the node reports build JSON, the server renders it

zh-CN: 浏览器不能直连节点：带 Origin 头的请求一律 403
en-US: Browsers never reach a node: any request with an Origin header is 403

zh-CN: Level 1 按模型声明按需实现：树、行操作、引用选择器、联动；Level 2 可选。不实现的端点回 404，服务端隐去或代办。
en-US: Level 1 is implemented on demand by what the model declares: tree, row operations, reference pickers, linkage; Level 2 is optional. An unimplemented endpoint answers 404 and the server hides or covers it.

zh-CN: 每个 SDK 都交付同一组能力
en-US: Every SDK ships the same set

zh-CN: 不是「某种语言功能多一点」：九个包跑同一套一致性测试，对着同一份 fixture。
en-US: Not one language ahead of another: nine packages run one conformance suite against one fixture.

zh-CN: 搜索、排序、分页；CHOICE、日期、布尔按语言类型自动推断 EditType
en-US: Search, sort and paging; CHOICE, dates and booleans infer their EditType from the language's own types

zh-CN: 表格选择器与树选择器，仓库只存被引用的主键，界面显示 label
en-US: Table and tree pickers; the repository stores the referenced key, the UI shows the label

zh-CN: 带表单、确认文案、ifExpr 和按用户显隐；返回的字符串在浏览器里当 JS 执行
en-US: With forms, confirm text, ifExpr and per-user visibility; a returned string runs as JavaScript in the browser

zh-CN: 和 Java 的 DataProxy 同名同义：before_fetch 追加 SQL 条件，validate 抛 Fail 给用户看到的提示
en-US: Same names and meaning as the Java DataProxy: before_fetch ANDs a SQL condition, validate raises Fail with a message the user sees

zh-CN: 每个用户的增删改权限由服务端决定；模型可再收紧，比如关掉 delete
en-US: Per-user add, edit and delete decided on the server; a model can tighten it further, say switch delete off

zh-CN: 注解属性有类型、能校验
原始 @Erupt / @Edit / @View 属性从 schema/ 生成类型，声明模型时就校验，拼错的 key 在启动时报错而不是在浏览器里静默
en-US: Raw @Erupt / @Edit / @View attributes are typed from schema/ and checked when the model is declared: a misspelt key fails at startup, not silently in the browser

zh-CN: 和 erupt 主仓保持同步的方式
en-US: How it keeps in step with erupt

zh-CN: schema/ 是两个仓库之间的全部契约。注解一变，九种语言的代码跟着重新生成，再跑一遍一致性测试。
en-US: schema/ is the whole contract between the two repositories. When an annotation changes, nine languages regenerate and the conformance suite runs again.

zh-CN: 注解改动后主仓重新生成 JSON Schema 与字段模板
en-US: After an annotation change the main repo regenerates the JSON Schema and field templates

zh-CN: 每周或手动按主仓分支 / tag 拉取，重新生成每种语言的代码并开 PR
en-US: Weekly, or by hand against a branch or tag, it pulls, regenerates every language and opens a pull request

zh-CN: 生成文件与 schema/ 不一致即失败；每个 SDK 对着同一份 fixture 过协议检查
en-US: A generated file that drifts from schema/ fails; every SDK passes the protocol checks against one fixture

zh-CN: databases 工作流把每个 SDK 的 SQL 仓库在真实 PostgreSQL 与 MySQL 上跑一遍
en-US: The databases workflow runs every SDK's SQL repository against real PostgreSQL and MySQL

zh-CN: 用你顺手的语言，接一个节点试试
en-US: Plug in a node in the language you already use

zh-CN: pip / go get / npm 装一个包，二十行代码，服务端多一个菜单。
en-US: pip, go get or npm one package, twenty lines of code, one more menu on the server.

zh-CN: 登录交给别人，账号留在自己手里
en-US: Delegate the login, keep the account

zh-CN: 把登录委托给 Keycloak、Okta、Entra ID 这类 OIDC 服务，或 GitHub、飞书、钉钉、企业微信这类 OAuth 平台。认证源在后台菜单里以数据行配置：选预设、粘凭据，不写代码、不改配置文件、不重启，保存后登录页立刻出现按钮。
en-US: Hand the login to an OIDC service such as Keycloak, Okta or Entra ID, or to an OAuth platform such as GitHub, Feishu, DingTalk or WeCom. A provider is a row in an admin menu: pick a preset, paste the credentials, no code, no config file, no restart, and the button is on the login page as soon as you save.

zh-CN: 标准授权码流程并强制 PKCE；授权码在服务端换令牌，令牌只用来调一次用户信息接口，全程不解析 id_token。
en-US: Standard authorization code with PKCE enforced; the code is exchanged on the server, the token is used for one userinfo call, and id_token is never parsed.

zh-CN: 点击登录页按钮，服务端生成 state 和 code_verifier，把「认证源 + verifier」存成一条 10 分钟的服务端记录，再 302 到授权地址。
en-US: The button hits the server, which mints a state and a code_verifier, stores provider + verifier server-side for 10 minutes, and 302s to the authorize URL.

zh-CN: 用户在 Keycloak / GitHub / 飞书那边登录并同意授权，认证源把浏览器送回回调地址，带 code 和 state。
en-US: The user logs in and consents at Keycloak, GitHub or Feishu; the provider sends the browser back to the callback with code and state.

zh-CN: state 只是一个键：缺失、过期、已用过或不属于该认证源都拒绝；首次使用即销毁，拿到另一个认证源上重放也不行。
en-US: The state is just a key: missing, expired, used or belonging to another provider is refused; it is burnt on first use, so it cannot be replayed elsewhere.

zh-CN: POST 令牌地址，带 code、code_verifier 和客户端凭据；默认 client_secret_post，发现文档只支持 client_secret_basic 时改用 HTTP Basic。
en-US: POST the token URL with code, code_verifier and client credentials; client_secret_post by default, HTTP Basic only when the discovery document says so.

zh-CN: Bearer 令牌 GET 用户信息地址，得到 claims；subject 依次取 sub / id / open_id / unionId 等第一个非空值，不需要配置。
en-US: GET userinfo with the bearer token and keep the claims; the subject is the first non-empty of sub, id, open_id, unionId and so on, nothing to configure.

zh-CN: 找绑定、匹配账号、必要时建号、检查状态；然后 302 回登录页只带一张 60 秒票据，前端 POST exchange 换成会话 token，token 不进地址栏。
en-US: Find the binding, match the account, create it if allowed, check status; then 302 back to the login page with a 60-second ticket that the frontend POSTs for a session token, so the token never enters the address bar.

zh-CN: 浏览器不携带任何可信状态
没有 Spring Security、没有 JWT 库，登录链自己走完；几条规则写在源码里，读得完。
en-US: No Spring Security, no JWT library, the login chain walks itself; the rules are in the source and short enough to read.

zh-CN: 对应服务端一条短时记录（认证源 + PKCE verifier），首次使用即销毁；同一个 state 不能在另一个认证源上重放。
en-US: It points at a short-lived server record (provider + PKCE verifier) burnt on first use; one state cannot be replayed against another provider.

zh-CN: 回调后浏览器只带一张 60 秒一次性票据回登录页，token 由 POST exchange 换得，不会出现在地址栏、历史记录和 Referer 里。
en-US: After the callback the browser carries a 60-second one-time ticket; the token comes from a POST, so it never appears in the address bar, history or Referer.

zh-CN: 登录页地址不来自请求参数
en-US: Login page path is never a parameter

zh-CN: 回调始终跳回 erupt-app.login-page-path（未配置时为 <host>/#/passport/login），不存在开放重定向。
en-US: The callback always returns to erupt-app.login-page-path (default <host>/#/passport/login), so there is no open redirect.

zh-CN: 客户端认证按发现文档
默认 client_secret_post；只有当 OIDC 发现文档声明仅支持 client_secret_basic 时才改用 HTTP Basic。客户端密钥只写不读，列表不显示、表单掩码回显。
en-US: client_secret_post by default; HTTP Basic only when the OIDC discovery document says it is the only option. The client secret is write-only: hidden in the table, masked in the form.

zh-CN: 与密码登录同一条链路
账号状态、有效期、IP 白名单检查以及 LoginProxy 的登录后处理对 SSO 登录同样生效；认证源放行不等于 erupt 放行。
en-US: Account status, expiry, IP whitelist and the LoginProxy post-login hooks apply to SSO logins too; the provider saying yes is not erupt saying yes.

zh-CN: 四个接口，都不需要登录
它们服务的正是尚未登录的用户，各自以 state、票据或「没有可保护的内容」为凭。
en-US: They serve users who are not logged in yet, each guarded by a state, a ticket, or by having nothing to protect.

zh-CN: 启用中的认证源：编码、名称、图标，不含密钥；登录页渲染按钮用
en-US: Enabled providers: code, name, icon, no secrets; the login page draws its buttons from it

zh-CN: 生成 state 与 PKCE 后 302 到认证源授权地址
en-US: Mints state and PKCE, then 302s to the provider's authorize URL

zh-CN: 认证源回调；成功 302 到登录页带 ssoTicket，失败带 ssoError
en-US: Provider callback; on success 302 to the login page with ssoTicket, on failure with ssoError

zh-CN: { ssoTicket } → 与密码登录相同的 LoginModel（含 token）；票据一次性、60 秒
en-US: { ssoTicket } → the same LoginModel as a password login, token included; ticket is one-time, 60 seconds

zh-CN: 回调固定跳回这里，不看请求参数
en-US: the callback always returns here, never to a parameter

zh-CN: 18 种预设，留给你的只有凭据
en-US: 18 presets; all that is left to you is the credentials

zh-CN: 选中预设后自动填入签发者或三个地址、授权范围、账号 / 姓名 / 邮箱 / 手机 / 头像声明与 Open ID 字段；地址里的 <host>、<realm>、<agentid> 占位符不替换，保存就被拒绝。
en-US: Picking a preset fills the issuer or the three URLs, scopes, the account / name / email / phone / avatar claims and the Open ID field; a leftover <host>, <realm> or <agentid> placeholder blocks the save.

zh-CN: 只填签发者，三个地址从 /.well-known/openid-configuration 自动发现并缓存
en-US: Fill the issuer only; the three URLs come from /.well-known/openid-configuration and are cached

zh-CN: 没有发现文档，预设填好授权、令牌、用户信息三个地址；飞书的信封式响应自动拆开
en-US: No discovery document; the preset fills the authorize, token and userinfo URLs. Feishu's envelope response is unwrapped for you

zh-CN: 钉钉 JSON 体换令牌、企业微信 CorpID + Secret 先换企业令牌再解析成员、微信开放平台 GET 带 openid，各走各的路
en-US: DingTalk exchanges with a JSON body, WeCom swaps CorpID + Secret for a corp token then resolves the member, WeChat Open Platform GETs with openid: each its own path

zh-CN: 所有字段手填，按标准 OAuth 2.0 处理
en-US: Every field by hand, treated as standard OAuth 2.0

zh-CN: 一次 SSO 登录怎么落到 erupt 用户上
en-US: How an SSO login lands on an erupt user

zh-CN: 绑定只认 subject，从不用邮箱或账号名做后续匹配：这两者会被改名和复用，subject 不会。
en-US: A binding trusts the subject only and never re-matches by email or account name: those get renamed and reused, a subject does not.

zh-CN: 「认证源 + subject」命中绑定表即为该用户，之后改账号名也不影响。
en-US: provider + subject hits the binding table and that is the user; renaming the account later changes nothing.
First login: match the account claim

zh-CN: 没有绑定时，取账号声明（为空则邮箱声明）与 erupt 用户表的 account 比对，匹配到就建立绑定，一生只发生一次。
en-US: Without a binding, the account claim (or the email claim) is compared with the erupt account; a match creates the binding, once in its lifetime.

zh-CN: 开启则按认证源资料创建用户，赋默认角色，密码不可用、只能走认证源；关闭则提示「系统中不存在对应账号」并带上声明名与值。
en-US: On: create the user from the provider's profile with the default roles and an unusable password; off: refuse with the claim name and value so an admin can create it.

zh-CN: 姓名、邮箱、手机、头像按「每次登录覆盖」或「仅补空」更新；登录时补齐默认角色只加不减。
en-US: Name, email, phone and avatar update by overwrite-on-login or fill-empty-only; roles granted on login are added, never revoked.

zh-CN: 账号停用、过期、不在 IP 白名单内的用户即使认证源放行也被拒绝，与密码登录一致。
en-US: A disabled, expired or off-whitelist account is refused even if the provider let it through, exactly as with a password.

zh-CN: 登录之后，绑定还能干别的
en-US: After login, the binding keeps working

zh-CN: 绑定记录了用户在供应商侧的 Open ID 和资料快照；其他模块拿它找人，erupt-notice 的推送渠道正是这样发消息的。
en-US: A binding records the user's Open ID on the provider side and a profile snapshot; other modules use it to reach the person, and erupt-notice's push channels send messages exactly this way.

zh-CN: 只读库中的绑定记录，不向供应商发请求；没登录过就没有绑定，返回空。
en-US: Reads the stored bindings only, never calls the provider; no login yet means no binding, so it returns empty.

zh-CN: 飞书侧的 open_id，推送卡片用
en-US: the user's open_id on Feishu, for pushing a card

zh-CN: 快照里任意顶层字段，不用为它加列
en-US: any top-level claim from the snapshot, no column needed

zh-CN: 以应用身份换令牌：飞书 / 钉钉 / 企业微信
en-US: app-level token: Feishu / DingTalk / WeCom only
SAML 2.0: JDK only, the hard part is refusing

zh-CN: SsoSamlService 406 行，没有任何 SAML / XML 安全依赖，全部建立在 JDK 的 javax.xml.crypto.dsig 上；一份响应能不能登录，取决于这张拒绝清单的顺序。
en-US: SsoSamlService is 406 lines with no SAML or XML security dependency, built entirely on the JDK's javax.xml.crypto.dsig; whether a response may log in depends on the order of this reject list.

zh-CN: 签名验不过、或签的不是断言本身
en-US: Signature fails, or signs something other than the assertion

zh-CN: 签名包装：签过的节点和读取的节点不是同一个
en-US: Signature wrapping: the signed node is not the node being read

zh-CN: 重放：ID 用过、InResponseTo 对不上
en-US: Replay: an ID seen before, an InResponseTo that does not match

zh-CN: 受众或收件人不是这个 erupt
en-US: Audience or recipient is not this erupt

zh-CN: 阅读第 23 期：SAML 的难点是拒绝 →
en-US: Read topic 23: the hard part of SAML is refusing →

zh-CN: 选一个预设，粘上凭据，登录页就多一个按钮
en-US: Pick a preset, paste the credentials, one more button on the login page

zh-CN: erupt-spring-boot-starter-all 已包含本模块；系统管理 → 单点登录，新增一行即是一个认证源。
en-US: Included in erupt-spring-boot-starter-all; System → SSO, and every new row is a provider.

zh-CN: 不依赖 Spring Security 的登录链 →
en-US: A login chain without Spring Security →

zh-CN: 把业务文档变成 AI 可检索的知识：上传 → 自动分块 → 向量嵌入 → 语义检索，全流程在后台可视化管理。AI 在对话中自主决定何时查哪个知识库，不用手动挂载。
en-US: Turn business documents into knowledge the AI can search: upload, chunk, embed, retrieve, all managed in the admin. In a conversation the AI decides on its own when to query which knowledge base, nothing to mount.

zh-CN: 从一份文档到一次召回
en-US: From a document to a hit

zh-CN: 上传 txt / md 或直接粘贴文本，系统自动分块、嵌入；状态流转 待嵌入 → 嵌入中 → 就绪，失败可重新嵌入。行操作「检索测试」直接验证召回与分数。
en-US: Upload txt / md or paste text; chunking and embedding run on their own, status moves pending → embedding → ready, and a failure can be re-embedded. The Retrieval Test row action checks hits and scores.

zh-CN: 备注：退换货、运费、保修期限
签收后 7 日内可无理由退货，需保持商品完好……
en-US: Returns within 7 days of delivery, item intact…

zh-CN: 退货运费：质量问题由商家承担，非质量问题由买家承担……
en-US: Return shipping: the seller pays for defects, the buyer otherwise…

zh-CN: 保修期自签收日起 12 个月，人为损坏不在保修范围……
en-US: Warranty 12 months from delivery; damage by misuse excluded…

zh-CN: AI 自己决定查哪个知识库
en-US: The AI picks the knowledge base itself

zh-CN: 检索以 AI Tool 的形式暴露：listKnowledgeBases 列出可用知识库，searchKnowledgeBase 对合适的那个发起语义检索，并优先采用召回内容作答。
en-US: Retrieval is exposed as AI tools: listKnowledgeBases lists what is available, searchKnowledgeBase runs a semantic search on the right one, and the answer prefers what was retrieved.

zh-CN: 客户说收到的耳机坏了，退货运费怎么算？
en-US: A customer's headphones arrived broken, who pays the return shipping?

zh-CN: 先看有哪些知识库，再挑和售后相关的那个……
en-US: List the knowledge bases first, then pick the one about after-sales…

zh-CN: 退货运费 质量问题
属于质量问题，退货运费由商家承担；签收 7 日内可无理由退货，保修期 12 个月。
en-US: It is a defect, so the seller pays return shipping; returns within 7 days of delivery, warranty 12 months.

zh-CN: 依据：售后政策 / 退换货规则 #2、#3
模型在对话中自主决定何时查、查哪个；没有「先选知识库再提问」这一步。
en-US: The model decides in conversation when and where to look; there is no pick-a-knowledge-base-first step.

zh-CN: 知识库的备注字段会被 AI 读取，用来判断它适不适合回答当前问题，所以请清晰描述内容范围。
en-US: The AI reads each knowledge base's remark to judge whether it fits the question, so describe its scope clearly.

zh-CN: 两个工具同样受 erupt-ai 的角色级 Tool 授权管控，可精细控制哪些角色允许检索哪些知识。
en-US: Both tools sit under erupt-ai's role-level tool authorization, so you control which roles may search which knowledge.

zh-CN: 知识库行操作里的可视化界面，输入问题即可看到召回的分块与相似度分数，调参不用猜。
en-US: A visual row action on the knowledge base: type a question and see the chunks and similarity scores, so tuning is not guesswork.

zh-CN: 嵌入模型在后台配，向量存储在文件里配
en-US: Embedding models in the admin, the vector store in the config

zh-CN: 嵌入模型菜单由 erupt-ai 提供，12 家提供商开箱即用；向量存储属于部署基础设施，不配置时自动选 classpath 里唯一可用的持久化实现，否则用内存。
en-US: The embedding model menu comes from erupt-ai with 12 providers built in; the vector store is infrastructure, and left unconfigured it picks the one persistent implementation on the classpath, else memory.

zh-CN: AI Manager → 嵌入模型，选提供商、填 Key，一个知识库绑定一个嵌入模型。
en-US: AI Manager → Embedding Model: pick a provider, paste a key, one knowledge base binds one model.

zh-CN: 向量维度在首次嵌入后不可修改；更换知识库的嵌入模型后需重新嵌入全部文档。
en-US: The vector dimension is fixed after the first embedding; switching a knowledge base's model means re-embedding every document.

zh-CN: 通过 erupt.ai.rag.vector-store 指定类型与 uri，可选 api-key 鉴权。
en-US: Set type and uri under erupt.ai.rag.vector-store, with an optional api-key.

zh-CN: 无需配置 · 适合开发调试
四个参数决定召回质量
每个知识库单独配置，默认值适合大多数中文文档；改完用检索测试看效果。
en-US: Set per knowledge base; the defaults suit most documents, and the retrieval test shows the effect of a change.

zh-CN: 每个分块的最大字符数；太大召回粗，太小丢上下文。
en-US: Maximum characters per chunk; too large and recall is coarse, too small and context is lost.

zh-CN: 相邻分块共享的字符数，让跨块的句子不被切断。
en-US: Characters shared by neighbouring chunks, so a sentence across the boundary survives.

zh-CN: 每次检索返回的分块数，连同相似度分数一起交给模型。
en-US: Chunks returned per search, handed to the model with their scores.

zh-CN: 相似度阈值 0~1，低于它的结果直接丢弃，不进上下文。
en-US: Similarity threshold 0 to 1; anything below is dropped before it reaches the context.

zh-CN: 上传第一份文档，让 AI 自己去翻
en-US: Upload the first document and let the AI look it up

zh-CN: 引入 erupt-ai-rag（需配合 erupt-ai），菜单里多出「知识库」。
en-US: Add erupt-ai-rag alongside erupt-ai and a Knowledge Base menu appears.

zh-CN: 不让大模型写一段话再由你去解析：向 System One 决策模型提出类型化的问题，拿回带概率分布的类型化答案。阈值放在代码里，模型只负责判断。
en-US: Instead of having the model write a paragraph you then parse, ask a System One decision model a typed question and get back a typed answer with a probability distribution. Thresholds live in your code; the model only judges.

zh-CN: 一张工单，三个问题，一次往返
en-US: One ticket, three questions, one round trip

zh-CN: 问题是不可变的值对象，声明为常量到处复用；多个问题一次问完，状态只读一次、一次计费。
en-US: Questions are immutable values declared once and reused; several questions go in one call, with the state read once and billed once.
not confident enough: hand to a human

zh-CN: 模型读的是描述，不是常量名
en-US: the model reads the description, not the constant name

zh-CN: Hi, I was charged twice this month and need this fixed today!
en-US: Hi, I was charged twice this month and need this fixed today!

zh-CN: 次往返问 N 个问题
种服务商 · 托管或自部署
问题自带类型，答案是概率
en-US: Questions carry a type, answers are probabilities

zh-CN: NOUL 的答案本身就是概率；CHOICE 与 SCORE 另带 0~1 的置信度，用来决定要不要采纳这个判断。
en-US: A NOUL answer is itself a probability; CHOICE and SCORE also carry a 0 to 1 confidence that decides whether to act on the judgement.

zh-CN: yes(0.9)：概率高于阈值才视为是
en-US: yes(0.9): only above the threshold counts as yes

zh-CN: 从封闭选项集中选一个
en-US: Pick one from a closed set

zh-CN: 赢家 + 全部选项的概率分布；选项来自枚举时答案就是枚举常量
en-US: The winner plus the whole distribution; with an enum the answer is the constant itself

zh-CN: above(0.8)：置信度足够才路由，否则转人工
en-US: above(0.8): route only when confident, else a human

zh-CN: 在有序等级上处于哪个位置
概率加权的位置，可落在两级之间；2~10 个等级
en-US: A probability-weighted position that may fall between levels; 2 to 10 levels

zh-CN: 判断标准放后台，改它不用发版
en-US: Criteria live in the admin, changing them needs no release

zh-CN: AI 决策 → 决策：把一组问题存成一条决策，业务代码、工作流或外部系统按决策编码调用。保存即校验，不合法的判断标准不会拖到生产环境才暴露。
en-US: AI Decision → Decisions: save a set of questions as one decision that code, workflows or external systems call by code. Validated on save, so a bad criterion never waits for production to surface.

zh-CN: 判断说明 / 选项 / 等级

en-US: Is the customer asking for a refund?

zh-CN: Decisions.run("ticket_triage", ticket) 或 HTTP POST /erupt-api/decision/{code}；答案按问题编码读取。
en-US: Decisions.run("ticket_triage", ticket) or HTTP POST /erupt-api/decision/{code}; answers are read by question code.
The key stays on the server

zh-CN: 两个 HTTP 接口都要求已登录；浏览器、脚本或下游服务不需要持有服务商的 API Key 就能拿到判断。
en-US: Both HTTP endpoints require login; browsers, scripts and downstream services get judgements without ever holding the provider's API key.

zh-CN: 行操作里粘一段状态，看实际应答的模型、token 用量和每个问题的答案与分布。
en-US: Paste a state in the row action and see the responding model, token usage, and every answer with its distribution.

zh-CN: POST /erupt-api/decision 直接带 questions 对象，type 为 noul / choice / score，不必先在后台建决策。
en-US: POST /erupt-api/decision with a questions object, type noul / choice / score, no admin decision needed first.

zh-CN: 两种服务商，一种应答格式
AI 决策 → 决策模型，选服务商后自动填好 API 域名与模型名；表单里的「连接测试」发一个最便宜的 NOUL 问题验证地址与 Key。
en-US: AI Decision → Decision Models: pick a provider and the API host and model name fill in; Test Connection sends the cheapest NOUL question to verify host and key.

zh-CN: TypeSafe 托管的 System One 模型，按量计费，需要 API Key；请求发往 {API 域名}/v1/systemone。
en-US: TypeSafe's hosted System One model, pay as you go, API key required; requests go to {host}/v1/systemone.

zh-CN: Convai Innovations 的 Apache 2.0 开源模型，在自己的机器上运行，应答格式与 Jev 一致；模块源码里附 FastAPI sidecar 与 Dockerfile。
en-US: Convai Innovations' Apache 2.0 open model, runs on your own machine with the same answer format as Jev; the module ships a FastAPI sidecar and Dockerfile.

zh-CN: 显式指定的模型 → 决策自带的模型 → 默认模型；using("名称") 与 ?model= 都按名称寻址。
en-US: Explicit model → the decision's own model → the default; using("name") and ?model= both address by name.

zh-CN: 新建的第一条自动成为默认，之后通过行操作切换；默认被锁定或删除时回退到任意一条已激活的。
en-US: The first model created becomes the default, switched later by a row action; a locked or deleted default falls back to any active model.

zh-CN: 按名称指定的模型必须处于激活状态，否则报 No such decision model，不会悄悄改用默认模型。
en-US: A model named explicitly must be active, otherwise No such decision model; it never silently swaps to the default.

zh-CN: 单次请求默认 15 秒；限流 429 或过载 529 时按退避重试，默认 2 次，优先遵循服务商的 retry-after。
en-US: 15 seconds per request by default; on 429 or 529 it backs off and retries, twice by default, honouring the provider's retry-after.

zh-CN: 把 if 后面那句话交给模型，阈值留给自己
en-US: Give the model the question, keep the threshold

zh-CN: erupt-spring-boot-starter-all 已包含本模块，只依赖 erupt-data-jpa，不需要 erupt-ai。
en-US: Included in erupt-spring-boot-starter-all; depends on erupt-data-jpa only, no erupt-ai required.
